summary: Iteration 2 (Restaurant pivot) - Both backend and frontend tested end-to-end. All critical restaurant flows work: 30 mesas seed, mesa/hotel/ifood/buffet orders, items enrichment with sector, mark-printed, close_order with 10% service fee + stock decrement (buffet skipped), cancel_order role check, sales list with channel populated. critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 869: `api.get("/health")(lambda: ...)` uses a sync lambda registered directly on the router — works but unusual; prefer @api.get async style.
close_order endpoint does not require admin/gerente role — any logged-in operator can close comandas; verify this matches business rules.
OrderDetail preview total in cart uses fixed 10% service (line 202-203) instead of using the user-configurable servicePercent state; can mislead before opening close dialog.

add_items endpoint does not enforce stock availability at add time; only checked implicitly during close_order (which does not check stock either — just decrements). Non-buffet items could go negative in stock.
close_order stock decrement (line 774) has no stock availability check — allows negative stock.
